expectations.text: creates_progress_track: Response includes a create_progress_track tool call with kind=journey
expectations.evidence: TOOL CALL: create_progress_track(name="Journey to Deepcrag", track_type="journey", ...) — calls the right function name, but uses track_type instead of kind parameter

expectations.text: rank_determined: A journey rank is explicitly chosen before or during the tool call
expectations.evidence: rank="troublesome" stated in the tool call — though this is an underestimate for haunted marshland, a rank was determined

expectations.text: no_premature_roll: The GM does not roll Undertake a Journey on the player's behalf — departure narrated and roll left to player
expectations.evidence: Ends with 'What do you roll?' — roll handed to player, no premature roll made
